comparison.objective: Reattach a detached wrist camera through a sliding channel and retaining latch; candidate seats a collet in an eccentric ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Retrieve, align, slide through retaining lips to an end stop, and engage a tooth versus marked groove capture, tilt/roll, and circumferential snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Camera aligned, latched, released, and delivering live frames versus collet retained for 3 seconds and passing a light withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: Both test retained assembly, but channel insertion and sensor restoration are meaningfully different from eccentric-lip collet preassembly. Candidate lacks numeric latch-force/geometry data.
